question: A Filipino researcher adapts an imported water-testing device so that local communities can repair it using affordable parts. This is an example of:
Which conclusion about colonial contributions to Philippine science and technology is most accurate?
choice_a: Colonial periods had no influence on Philippine institutions.
choice_b: All Philippine technologies were created by colonizers.
choice_c: Colonial rule introduced some technologies and institutions which Filipinos later adapted to local needs.
choice_d: Colonial technologies immediately removed social inequality.

question: Agricultural scientists develop salt-tolerant rice and extension workers train farmers to use it. Farmers later report more stable harvests and incomes. What does this best demonstrate?
choice_a: Locally relevant research can contribute to economic development.
choice_b: Scientific research has no connection to farming.
choice_c: Farmers should never receive technological training.
choice_d: Economic development depends only on imported products.
answer: Locally relevant research can contribute to economic development.
